shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls -la src app pages components 2>/dev/null | head -50

for f in .gitignore index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== node_modules/@gravity-ui"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)"; ls node_modules/.bin | head -50; ls __agent_eval__

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|types|module)"' ; ls build 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o "export {[^}]*}" build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -c 3000; echo; find . -name "index.d.ts" -path "*build*" | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls; echo ---; cat index.d.ts | head -150
ls controls layout; echo ---SELECT; cat Select/Select.d.ts | head -120; echo ---SWITCH; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -60; echo ---CHECKBOX; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -60

cat Select/types.d.ts | head -150; echo ---CONTROLTYPES; cat types.d.ts | head -80; echo ---TEXTINPUT; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; echo ---AVATAR; cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -60

cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -60; echo ---BUTTON; cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; echo ---CARD; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; echo ---TEXT; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ---FLEX; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -30; echo ---LABEL; ls Label

cat Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls Avatar; echo ---; cat Avatar/types/common.d.ts; echo ---; grep -n "variant" text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls Text; grep -rn "header-1\|body-1" Text/*.d.ts Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -o "BUTTON_VIEWS = \[[^]]*\]" Button/constants.d.ts Button/constants.js 2>/dev/null; cat Button/constants.js | head -20

cat Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Avatar; cat Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts | head -20; cat ../../../../../../node_modules/.bin/tsc >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc -v && node -e "console.log(typeof Intl.supportedValuesOf)"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

grep -n "label" controls/TextInput/TextInput.js | head -20; grep -rn "label" controls/common/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; ls controls/common; grep -n "Label\|label" Select/Select.js | head -15; grep -n "content\|text" Select/tech-components.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls Select; ls Alert; sed -n 1,40p Alert/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null
ls ControlLabel && cat ControlLabel/*.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "ControlLabel" index.d.ts | head -2
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -60

ls node_modules | grep -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; command -v chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; npx vitest --version 2>/dev/null
rm -rf dist && npx vitest run --environment node 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -60
npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -60
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -8 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && echo "---" && wc -l src/App.tsx src/profile/*
